rounds.text: York Exports Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.80x and a P/E ratio of only 3.71 [E1, E2]. The company demonstrates a powerful upward trajectory in capital efficiency, with the median return on equity accelerating from 9% over the last decade to 24% in the most recent year [E20, E23]. This consistent improvement in profitability, supported by a 5-year median ROE of 16% and a 3-year median ROE of 19%, highlights a business that is becoming increasingly effective at generating returns for shareholders [E21, E22]. Furthermore, the company maintains a solid ROCE of 14.2% alongside a steady 10% compounded sales growth rate over the last ten years [E6, E8]. Conceded: the company offers a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4]. Given the current market capitalisation of ₹ 21.2 Cr, the market is failing to price in the company's demonstrated ability to scale its returns on equity [E3, E62].
